title: Multiplicative connection bounds above criticality
exact_target: When does percolation connectivity on a nonamenable hyperbolic graph satisfy a uniform multiplicative upper bound through points on geodesics?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000040 (AMR-099-0040). CC BY 4.0.
